reason: A DeepSeek Harness guard that maintains agent task-plan freshness by reminding the model to update unfinished todos and temporarily blocking ordinary tools when the plan remains stale.

summaries.zh: 通过提醒并在待办状态过期时暂时阻止普通工具调用，帮助 DeepSeek Harness 智能体保持任务计划与实际进度一致。
summaries.en: Helps DeepSeek Harness agents keep task plans aligned with actual progress by reminding them to update stale todos and temporarily blocking ordinary tool calls when needed.

capabilities: Tracks non-bookkeeping tool attempts within a session
Injects a reminder to reconcile unfinished todo items
Blocks ordinary tools when the todo list remains stale
Keeps todo_write and the outer run_code recovery path available
